prompt: Create a photorealistic sports portrait of a smiling middle-aged male rugby player standing on a muddy rugby field at night after a match. He is centered in a medium shot from thighs to head, facing the camera with relaxed confidence, wearing a black padded scrum cap, wrist tape, muddy white shorts, and a short-sleeve rugby jersey with broad horizontal navy blue and off-white stripes and a small shield-style crest on the left chest. His face and arms are lightly muddy, his jersey is heavily stained with wet dirt, and visible breath vapor hangs beside his head in the cold air. The background is a softly blurred stadium pitch with wet grass, puddles reflecting light, faint spectators, tall rugby goalposts on the right, and bright floodlights glowing in the upper left. Use shallow depth of field, realistic rain or mist particles, cinematic documentary sports photography, natural skin texture, high dynamic range, cool night color grading, crisp subject detail, and authentic post-game atmosphere. No text, no watermark, no exaggerated muscles, no extra players in the foreground.

promptZh: 创作一张写实风格的体育肖像，主角是一位面带微笑的 中年男性橄榄球运动员，站在赛后泥泞的橄榄球场上。画面为从大腿到头部的中景构图，主角居中，自信而放松地面对镜头，佩戴黑色软质橄榄球头盔，手腕缠着运动胶带，身穿沾满泥土的白色短裤和短袖橄榄球衫，球衫上有宽大的水平 海军蓝与米白色 条纹，左胸处有一个小盾牌徽章。他的脸部和手臂沾有少量泥土，球衫上布满了湿润的污渍，寒冷的空气中可以看到他呼出的水汽。背景是虚化的体育场草坪，地面湿润，水洼反射着光线，隐约可见观众，右侧矗立着高大的橄榄球门柱，左上方是明亮的泛光灯。采用浅景深、逼真的雨水或雾气颗粒效果，呈现电影级纪实体育摄影质感，具备自然的皮肤纹理、高动态范围、冷色调夜间调色、清晰的主体细节以及真实的赛后氛围。画面中不得包含文字、水印，不得过度夸张肌肉，前景中不得出现其他球员。
